lines.trans: Sister Xingzi and Kaiwen came back.
Nothing major—they said they do not want to handle production matters anymore.
And what about you?
I am not sure either.
Right now I just want to stay here and keep you company.
Then stay here and keep me company.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 他的习惯是不带实习生的。
examples.trans: His habit is never taking on interns.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.
Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?
Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 我看他们太忙了，就想上去帮把手。
examples.trans: I saw they were too busy, so I wanted to step up and lend a hand.

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？

examples.trans: It is not as if we only have one plan.

examples.text: 因为我们不用和他开会！
examples.trans: Because we do not have to attend meetings with him!

meanings.note: reduplicated adverb meaning thoroughly and wholeheartedly

examples.text: 不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。
examples.trans: No need to thank me; if you really want to thank me, just work hard.

examples.text: 今天晚上回去好好休息一下。
examples.trans: Go back tonight and get a good rest.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 暴雨直播那天，全组人员在雨里坚守到了最后。
examples.trans: On the day of the storm broadcast, the whole crew stood fast in the rain.

examples.text: 窗外下起了瓢泼暴雨，街上行人很少。
examples.trans: Torrential rain poured outside, leaving few people on the street.

examples.text: 气象台的暴雨预警刚刚又更新了！
examples.trans: The weather bureau's rainstorm alert has just been updated again!

examples.text: 节目官方微博每十分钟更新一次路况互助信息。
examples.trans: The show's official Weibo updates road mutual-aid info every ten minutes.

examples.text: 不要老想着自己是实习生没经验。
examples.trans: Stop always thinking that you are an intern with no experience.
In a little while you will find out.

examples.text: 从今以后，二部的人归一部现场组管。
examples.trans: From now on, Unit Two staff are overseen by Unit One's floor team.
Who is in charge of this office?

examples.text: 气象台刚刚发布了特大暴雨红色预警！
examples.trans: The weather bureau just issued a red-alert rainstorm warning!

examples.text: 摄像机亮起红色指示灯，代表画面正在直播。
examples.trans: When the camera tally light turns red, that feed is live on air.

examples.text: 你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？

examples.trans: That would be wonderful, thank you!

meanings.note: Verb péi ('keep company, spend time with').

examples.text: 还要肯花时间陪女朋友。
examples.trans: He must also be willing to spend time with his girlfriend.

examples.text: 周末她留在医院陪刚做完手术的同事。
examples.trans: Over the weekend she stayed at the hospital with her coworker.

examples.text: 市气象台的暴雨预警刚刚升级为红色预警！
examples.trans: The city weather bureau just upgraded the storm alert to red!

examples.text: 户外大型活动必须建立完善的极端天气预警机制。
examples.trans: Large outdoor events need robust extreme-weather alert plans.
